Action Energy / Carbon Trust (2003). Steam generation costs. Energy Consumption Guide ECG066. Action Energy programme, Carbon Trust, London. First printed August 1997; revised and updated April 2003. Crown copyright.

Locators are printed page numbers (PDF page = printed + 1; the cover is unnumbered). 12-page guide analysing UK energy surveys of 300 boilers at over 100 industrial, public and commercial sites. Main file (4 technologies): overall boilerhouse thermal efficiency (gross/HHV) for all fuels (Table 1 best/average/poorest 81.7/74.2/51.0), gas-fired boilerhouses (76.0%), generic modern boiler (~80%) and the post-measure average (79.5%). These are annual operating efficiencies including standby, low-load and blowdown losses, so they sit below steady-state test efficiencies. _measures.csv: quantified savings of the recommended measures (O2 trim, blowdown recovery, economisers, sequencing, dampers). _other-values.csv: steam generation costs standardised to a fuel price of 1.0 p/kWh (these are fuel-only costs = 1/efficiency, not opex), point-of-use steam cost, Figure 2 per-fuel averages read from the chart, blowdown loss and Table 6 gross calorific values. Not loaded: Table 4 recommendation counts, worked-example inputs, steam tables. Traps: Table 6 gas oil Btu/lb printed 9,500 (should be ~19,500). Not ECG092 (steam distribution costs, carbon-trust_2004_001); ECG066 refers to ECG067 for distribution.
